hooks.text: 夜里潜地牢偷货，白天开店把赃物卖出暴利
hooks.excerpt: You are Vyke the goblin, a thief who sneaks into dungeons to plunder treasures by night, and a merchant who sells the loot for massive profits by day.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 敏捷逃脱、诡计控场或正面偷武器，三套流派重写潜行
hooks.excerpt: Upgrading your talent tree doesn’t just enhance your exploration and survival abilities—it also unlocks different playstyles! Go for the Agile Thief build: use your Grappling Hook to escape pursuits and Shadow Rewind to return to position, completely throwing enemies off. Prefer the Cunning Tactician build? Toss Coinbeetles to manipulate enemies’ movements or Play Dead until the coast is clear. Or choose the Aggressive Brute build: leap from heights to Stun Stomp enemies, or even stand in front of a guard and snatch their equipment with a Steal Parry!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 掷骰配讨价技能可卖到三倍价，但说服过头顾客会翻脸
hooks.excerpt: The rules are simple: roll the dice multiple times and pair them with the appropriate Haggle Skills to increase the customer’s Persuasion. Convince the customer, and you can sell the items for up to three times the original price. But be careful: if you exceed the required Persuasion points, the customer will immediately turn against you.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
